rating_input: Official ICC team ratings (ODI table dated 18 Oct 2026; T20I tables dated 14-18 Oct 2026). The ICC site's rankings tables did not render server-side when fetched; values were cross-checked against three independent republications of the same official ICC tables (Wisden, ESPNcricinfo rankings page, ICC Women's site) which agree exactly. Row source links point to the official ICC rankings pages.
model: Win Match moneyline only (the only match market OLBG lists for cricket fixtures): p = 1/(1+exp(-(rating_diff + home_adj)/divisor)); ODI divisor 18, home_adj +6 rating points; T20I divisor 30, home_adj +8. Neutral-venue matches get no home adjustment. Match-runs totals are NOT originated: no verified venue run-rate inputs were collected, so that market is left blank rather than invented.
